dispositions.reason: Stage P results are blocked folds inside one season and carry no skill claim per acceptance criteria. No supported gain can be claimed from Stage P or one season.
2019 held-out Stage T shows R2 vs R1 paired skill negative with upper 95% bound below zero, i.e. no improvement beyond PM2.5-only baseline.
Inputs gated out by M5 or not assessed are excluded by acceptance criteria.
FIRMS MODIS SP availability is unknown; issue-time validity cannot be confirmed from the package.

output.plan: Run T+6 hourly PM2.5 experiment restricted to issue-time-valid inputs only. Baseline R1 = PM2.5-only. Test R2 = PM2.5 + IMERG Early with enforced input cutoff 4.0 h and NEA cutoff 2.0 h. Exclude all M5-gated-out or not-assessed sources. Do not claim supported gain from Stage P or single-season results. Report 2019 held-out MAE all hours and >55 µg/m3 with paired skill and 95% bounds.
claims: 2019 held-out R1 MAE all hours is 9.874 ug/m3
2019 held-out R2 MAE all hours is 11.208 ug/m3
R2 vs R1 all-hours paired skill is -0.135
R2 vs R1 all-hours paired skill upper 95% bound is -0.039
limitations: FIRMS MODIS SP availability unknown; issue-time validity not confirmed.
Wind speed/direction from ERA5 is retrospective only and excluded.
Soil moisture SMAP L3 and satellite imagery MCD64A1/HLS/Maiac are gated out or hindsight.
Stage P MAE values carry no skill claim.
